item.description:
Nexa 1.0.9

  • Backup relays can now reach Nexa without an app update. When a relay stops working and none of the built-in backups work either, Nexa can use one from a list signed by Nexa's developer. This only happens with Tor or a proxy on, so that relay never sees your IP address, and Nexa uses at most one such relay at a time. Settings shows which relay came from the list and who runs it. To get the list, Nexa asks its relays for it once a day, through Tor or your proxy only; the request says nothing about you.
  • When a relay stops working, each Mac now picks its replacement in its own order, so not everyone moves to the same backup at once.
  • Security update for the Go code in the built-in Tor's bridge transports.
